name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence clauses for blocker_moved, has_door_key, and door_open are redundant. They are already forced by the precedence chain ending in the hard Existence(target_picked_up): Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open), Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) together guarantee that blocker_moved, has_door_key, and door_open must occur before the required target_picked_up. Remove the three redundant Existence clauses and keep only Existence(target_picked_up) together with the three Precedence clauses.

texts: Pick up the target box (target_picked_up) at least once
The door cannot be opened before the blocking ball is moved (blocker_moved before door_open)
The door cannot be opened before the key is acquired (has_door_key before door_open)
The target box cannot be picked up before the door is opened (door_open before target_picked_up)
